cues.en: There he is. Finally.
cues.zh: 他来了。终于啊。

cues.en: I went ahead and started without you. Ladies, this is Jesse Son. He's in for the full treatment. Hey. Take off your shoes. Lay back.
cues.zh: 我等不及就先开始了。姑娘们，这位是 Jesse Son。他要来个全套护理。嘿，把鞋脱了，躺下吧。

cues.en: Exfoliate.

cues.en: It'll be later. So where's the mice? What is he out park in a minivan? It'll look like a shadow. Here's where he's at. What am I doing here?

cues.en: I

cues.en: was gonna have you two flip a coin.

cues.en: Since the genius can't be bothered,
cues.zh: 既然那位天才懒得露面，

cues.en: today's your lucky day. Look around, kiddo. It's all yours.
cues.zh: 今天就是你的幸运日了。看看四周吧，孩子，这全都是你的了。

cues.en: What?
cues.zh: 什么？

cues.en: This?
cues.zh: 这个？

cues.en: Yeah. You are now the owner of this fine establishment.

cues.en: For free?
cues.zh: 免费送我？

cues.en: Free. Oh, ladies, cover your ears. No.
cues.zh: 免费？女士们，捂住耳朵。不是。

cues.en: Not free.
cues.zh: 不是免费的。

cues.en: Look. Hey. This is a squeaky clean, highly profitable, at least potentially,
cues.zh: 听着。这是一家干净得发亮、利润丰厚的店，至少有潜力成为……

cues.en: local institution.
cues.zh: 本地名店。

cues.en: Looked upon with favor by the Chamber of Commerce, Better Business Bureau at $312,000.
cues.zh: 深受商会和商业改进局青睐，售价只要 31.2 万美元。

cues.en: It's a steal. 312,000.
cues.zh: 简直是捡漏。31.2 万。

cues.en: Don't
cues.zh: 你

cues.en: you get it? On the outside, it's a nail salon. Right? On the inside,
cues.zh: 还不明白吗？表面上，它是家美甲店，对吧？实际上，

cues.en: it's the best money laundry a growing boy could ask for.
cues.zh: 它是一个成长中的小伙子梦寐以求的最佳洗钱场所。

cues.en: Wait. Wait. Wait. Hey. Ladies, thank you. Thank you. Good job. Come back here. Sit.
cues.zh: 等等，等等，等等。姑娘们，谢谢，辛苦了，干得不错。回来，坐下。

cues.en: Come on. Come on.
cues.zh: 快点，过来。

cues.en: Humor me here for a second.
cues.zh: 先听我把话说完。

cues.en: You know you need to launder your money. Right?
cues.zh: 你知道你需要洗钱，对吧？

cues.en: Do you understand the basics of it? Placement, layering, integration.
cues.zh: 你懂基本流程吗？存放、分拆、整合。

cues.en: I ain't buying no damn nail salons, so just forget it. Well, you wanna stay out of jail, don't you? I mean, you wanna keep your money and your freedom.
cues.zh: 我绝不买什么破美甲店，想都别想。好吧，但你也不想坐牢，对吧？我是说，你既想要钱，又想要自由。

cues.en: Because I got three little letters for you, IRS.
cues.zh: 那我就给你提三个字母：IRS（美国国税局）。

cues.en: If they can get Capone, they can get you. Hey. Look.
cues.zh: 他们能抓到卡彭，就能抓到你。嘿，看。

cues.en: Here's you. Right? Pink. Pinkman. Get it? K.
cues.zh: 这是你。对吧？平克。平克曼。懂了吗？好。

cues.en: Here's your cash. You're out on the town.
cues.zh: 这是你的现金。你出门狂欢。

cues.en: Yeah. You're partying hardy. You're knocking boots with the chickie babes. Oh, who's this?
cues.zh: 没错，你玩得嗨翻天，跟妹子们滚床单。哦，这是谁？

cues.en: It's the tax man, and he's looking at you. Now what does he see? He sees a young fella with a big fancy house,
cues.zh: 是税务员，他正盯着你呢。他看到什么？他看到一个小伙子，有一栋气派的大房子，

cues.en: unlimited cash supply,
cues.zh: 用不完的现金，

cues.en: and no job. Now what is the conclusion the tax man makes?
cues.zh: 却没有工作。那税务员会得出什么结论？

cues.en: I'm a drug dealer.
cues.zh: 我是毒贩。

cues.en: Wrong.
cues.zh: 错。

cues.en: Million times worse.
cues.zh: 比那严重一百万倍。

cues.en: You're a tax cheat.
cues.zh: 你是个逃税犯。

cues.en: What do they do? They take every penny and you go in the can for felony tax evasion.
cues.zh: 他们会怎么做？没收你的每一分钱，而且你还得因为重度逃税罪去蹲大牢。

cues.en: Ouch.
cues.zh: 真惨。

cues.en: What was your mistake?
cues.zh: 你犯了什么错？

cues.en: You didn't launder your money.
cues.zh: 你没有洗钱。

cues.en: Now
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: you give me your money. Okay? That's called placement.
cues.zh: 你把钱交给我。对吧？这叫“存放”。

cues.en: Hand me that little thing, bin.
cues.zh: 把那个小东西递给我，那个桶。

cues.en: This is the nail salon. Right? I take your dirty money and I slip it into the salon's nice, clean cash flow.
cues.zh: 这就是美甲店。对吧？我拿到你的脏钱，然后把它混进美甲店干干净净的现金流里。

cues.en: That's called layering.
cues.zh: 这就叫分层。

cues.en: Final step, integration.
cues.zh: 最后一步，整合。

cues.en: The revenues from the salon go to the owner. That's you. Your filthy drug money has been transformed into nice, clean, taxable income
cues.zh: 沙龙的收入归老板。也就是你。你那笔肮脏的毒品钱，现在变成了干净、合法、要交税的收入

cues.en: brought to you by a savvy investment in a thriving business.
cues.zh: 这都要归功于你精明地投资了一家生意兴隆的店。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: you want me to buy this place so I can pay taxes?
cues.zh: 你是想让我买下这家店，这样我就能交税？

cues.en: I'm a criminal, yo. Yeah.
cues.zh: 我是个罪犯，老兄。没错。

cues.en: And if you wanna stay a criminal and not become, say, a convict,
cues.zh: 要是你想继续当罪犯，而不是变成个囚犯之类的，

cues.en: then maybe you should grow up and listen to your lawyer. Right.
cues.zh: 那你或许该成熟点，听听律师的话。对吧。

cues.en: So you can get your 5%?
cues.zh: 好让你拿走你的5%？

cues.en: No. That's 17%.
I heard you said five.
cues.zh: 我明明听你说的是5%。

cues.en: You said it right in front of me. Yeah. That was for your partner. It's privileges
cues.zh: 你当着我的面说的。对，那是给你合伙人的。算是资历深

cues.en: of seniority and all. But for you, it's usual. 17%,
cues.zh: 带来的特权吧。但对你来说，还是按规矩办。17%，

cues.en: and and that's a bargain.
cues.zh: 这已经很划算了。

cues.en: Hey. What you... Hey. Listen to it. Come on. I'm talking to you about your future here. Listen to reason.
cues.zh: 嘿，你干嘛……嘿，听着。别这样。我可是在跟你聊你的未来。讲点道理好不好。
